text: The purpose of this report is to request further instructions for the Ontario Land Tribunal appeal respecting the development application at 383 and 387 Sherbourne Street. The applicant appealed the proposed Zoning By-law Amendment Application for 383 and 387 Sherbourne Street to the Ontario Land Tribunal on January 26, 2022, due to City Council's failure to make a decision on the application within the time prescribed by the Planning Act.

City Council on July 19 and 20, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 5, 2023) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendices A and B to the report (July 5, 2023) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 5, 2023) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege. The confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 5, 2023) from the City Solicitor were adopted by City Council and are now public as follows: 1.
